title: [VIC, NSW, QLD, SA] FoxESS EQ4800 Battery 21kWh from $6691 @ Goal Solar
body:
Deal: [VIC, NSW, QLD, SA] FoxESS EQ4800 Battery 21kWh from $6691 @ Goal Solar

[Bruceflix] Ozbargain transitioned to a battery ad service so gradually that we barely noticed until it was too late
[nikoris] So many stupid free games in front page but THIS bothers you? lmfao
[OZKap] I'd rather have a free game I'll never play than be advertised another overpriced solar battery by a company with zero history on Ozbargain and next to zero history in the real world.
[clandestino] The free games are very transparent about cost and revenue.
Cost: $0
Revenue: $0
In my experience, the free games don't make any claims about future savings that will offset your initial outlay.
[Zythyx] Ozbargain has been trading in Batteries for over a decade. How many Eneloops do you have? I have enough to build my own home storage battery system by now.
[sprof] How are any of the solar spams Bargins FFS
[DannyBoy] Yeah this is not a deal, FoxESS is more competitive in price than this
[Lucille Bluth] Not even close to being a competitively priced deal
Cheaper for bigger battery in the below deal, which I wouldn't call a good deal either.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/970010
Our commitment to quality and integrity in every project has propelled us to become one of Australia’s leading solar companies
Every single solar company claims to be Australia's leading solar company lol. Even though they have only operated for less than two years lmao. Good luck with them being around for warranty claims in a few years.
Business name
GOAL SOLAR 10 Oct 2024
[furythree] whats the price range we should be looking for, for 40kw + inverter?

[ol mate] Meter box photo (showing NMI + single/3 phase)
Pretty sure a NMI isn't usually on the meter box. The meter number is, but not the NMI.
[WatchNerd] Getting fed up with all these fake bargain solar spam posts. And as mentioned above by Lucille, better deal elsewhere.
